root_cause.text: In the omap_crypto_copy_sg_lists() function, the kmalloc_array() call used sizeof(*sg), which is the size of a pointer (since sg is a pointer-to-pointer), instead of sizeof(*new_sg), the size of a struct scatterlist, leading to an under-allocation of the scatterlist array.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes the allocation from `sizeof(*sg)` to `sizeof(*new_sg)`, and the commit message explicitly states: "The existing allocation of scatterlists in omap_crypto_copy_sg_lists() was allocating an array of scatterlist pointers, not scatterlist objects, resulting in a 4x too small allocation."
